welcome.title: Getting started
welcome.subtitle: Four steps from zero to your first governed agent call.
welcome.step1Body: Your operator session is active. Every dashboard and API call is scoped to the tenant below.
welcome.step2Body: Pick a language and install the SauronID client.
welcome.step3Title: Register your first agent and make a leashed call
welcome.step3Body: This registers an agent identity and makes one signed, policy-checked call through the governance layer.
welcome.step4Waiting: Waiting for your first event — checking every 3 seconds.
welcome.needKey: Need a key? Issue one on the Provision page

onboard.title: Provision
onboard.subtitle: Create tenants, issue SDK keys, and add dashboard operators — without editing environment variables for keys.
onboard.superOnly: This action requires a super operator session.
onboard.shownOnce: Shown once — copy it now. It is not stored anywhere.
onboard.tenantBody: Tenants are created on first use — this registers the name for the tenant switcher in this browser.
onboard.tenantHint: Allowed: letters, digits, dash, underscore (max 64). To make it visible to every operator, also add it to SAURONID_TENANTS in the dashboard environment.
onboard.tenantCreated: Tenant "{name}" registered. It becomes real on its first API call.
onboard.keyBody: Issues a scoped, tenant-locked admin JWT signed by the core. Static env keys (SAURON_ADMIN_KEY) remain the break-glass path.
onboard.opBody: Operators live in the SAURON_DASHBOARD_OPERATORS environment variable, so they cannot be created at runtime. This generates the JSON fragment to paste there — the password is hashed server-side and never stored.
onboard.opPasteHint: Merge this fragment into the SAURON_DASHBOARD_OPERATORS JSON object (env file or compose), then restart the dashboard.

explorer.title: API explorer
explorer.subtitle: Admin and read endpoints exposed through the dashboard proxy.
explorer.hint: Proxy curls are same-origin and authenticate with your sauron_session cookie — copy its value from your browser into $SAURON_SESSION. Core curls hit the core directly with the static admin key.
